name: Chris Xrisakis
title: Striker
description: A skinny striker in a red-and-white striped kit, blue jeans, and a fighting stance. He fights like a through-ball: wait for the lane, then vanish onto it.
source_description: Male fighter, skinny, curly brown hair, red white striped football shirt, blue jeans, dark sneakers.
special_desc: Bursts through the defensive line like a threaded pass.
ultimate_desc: One last surge that hits like a stoppage-time winner.
